article.title: Build 1.60.1.70938: Enhancement Shaman tooltips reworked and classic epics added

changes.before: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 3 to 13 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Flametongue Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.
